title: BOB service definition
description:
Schema for a single service entry inside services.json or a *.json file dropped into ~/.config/bob/services.d/.

SCOPE: This schema validates the structural and syntactic shape of a service entry. It does NOT enforce all runtime constraints. The following invariants are validated by bob.registry.Service.from_dict() at load time and CANNOT be expressed in pure JSON Schema:
  * cross-service uniqueness of `id` across all loaded services (a single document can pass schema validation but fail at runtime when its IDs clash with another file)
  * `config_key` must not be a Python reserved keyword (the regex permits any valid identifier; the keyword check is runtime-only)

A document that validates against this schema is structurally well-formed; whether it loads successfully into BOB also depends on the runtime checks above. Schema major version: 1 (additive changes only within v1; breaking changes bump to v2 and gate via the optional `schema_version` field on plugin file wrappers — see plugin-file.schema.json).

Identifier.description: Lowercase identifier used for service IDs and similar slug-like fields.

PythonIdentifier.description: Valid Python identifier shape. NOTE: Python reserved keywords are NOT excluded by this schema; the runtime validator rejects them.

PackageName.description: Package identifier as understood by the host package manager (apt, dnf, …). The current build is Debian/Ubuntu-focused; future multi-PM support may expand this to a typed object.

SystemdUnit.description: systemd unit name (with or without a .service suffix).

PortProto.description: Port descriptor in 'number/proto' form. Number is 1–65535, proto is tcp or udp. NOTE: this string-based encoding will be replaced by a typed object {port,proto} in schema v2; do not extend with new sub-fields here.

BinaryRef.description: Bare command name (resolved via $PATH at runtime) or absolute path. Schema v2 will switch to a typed union {name|path}.

id.description: Identifier for the service (e.g. 'ssh', 'nginx'). Cross-service uniqueness is enforced at runtime, not by this schema.

packages.description: Package names looked up via the host package manager. Empty array is allowed for binary-only / snap-only services.

services.description: systemd units checked for active/enabled state.

ports.description: Default ports in 'number/proto' format. Required when config_key='fixed'. Range strictly 1–65535.

risk.description: Risk classification — drives default scoring weight when the service is exposed.

config_key.description: Historical port-resolution strategy, kept for compatibility. It no longer selects behaviour: since v0.15.2 a service's config is read whenever detection.config_files names one, whatever this field says. 'ask' never had an implementation, and no service uses the free-form identifier form. Retiring the field is a contract change and is queued, not done.

detection.description: Extended detection hints for services not installable via the host package manager alone. At least one of `binary`, `snap`, or `config_files` should be non-empty if provided — an empty `detection: {}` adds no signal.

binary.description: Bare command names (resolved via $PATH) or absolute paths.

snap.description: Snap package names checked via 'snap list'.

config_files.description: Absolute config file paths used to auto-detect the service port (when config_key='auto').

allOf.title: config_key='fixed' requires at least one port
config_key='auto' requires detection.config_files (else nothing to parse)
Service must be detectable: at least one of packages, services, or detection.{binary|snap}
